eu_tesat_2026.interpretation: These are EU-level reported figures for terrorism activity and arrests, not membership counts of terrorist organizations.

splc_active_club_2024.interpretation: SPLC's map lists many U.S. Active Club locations. Store these as locations/chapters, not people.

provenance_rule: Every numerical field must carry a year, unit, scope and source. A reported incident count is never converted into an organization membership count. A location list is never converted into a member count. A legal designation is never converted into a statement of ideology without source context.
